camel_example: aliyun polardb CheckPolarFsQuotaConsistency --region cn-hangzhou --Path '/test' --EnableRepair false --PolarFsInstanceId 'pfs-test0000' --EnableStrictCalculate false
description_en: Checks the consistency of quota settings in a PolarFS instance
description_zh: 用于检查PolarFS实例中配额设置的一致性状态
kebab_example: aliyun polardb check-polar-fs-quota-consistency --polar-fs-instance-id pfs-test0000 --path /test --enable-repair false --enable-strict-calculate false --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckPolarFsQuotaConsistency

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarFS instance
parameters.name: polar_fs_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to repair an inconsistent quota. Valid values:

- false

- true
parameters.help_zh:
修复不一致配额，示例值：

* false
* true
parameters.name: enable_repair

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to calculate the total usage of the directory in strict mode. Valid values:

- false

- true
parameters.help_zh:
在严格模式下计算目录的总使用量，示例值：

* false
* true
parameters.name: enable_strict_calculate
